description: Victoria Traffic Count Locations is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Department of Transport and Planning, VIC. This dataset contains the location, GPS coordinates and textual description of all traffic counts conducted by VicRoads over the past 20+ years. VicRoads collects thousands of counts each year across the state. The type of equipment used determines the accuracy and the type of data collected. For example data collected at Traffic Lights (SCATS) does not distinguish between cars and trucks. Coverage is Victoria; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-05-13. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
